title: dropdown when over 5 no truncate
rule: Dropdown when >5 — logical sort; option text fully displayed. Dual-cite NN/g dropdown band; this is Ant's cutoff + no-truncate.
pass_when: A >5 set uses a dropdown (on this Ant surface), options logically sorted, text fully displayed.
fail_when: >5 as a radio list on this Ant surface, truncated option text, or unsorted dump.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A house winner vs NN/g ~5–10 / combobox ~15+ / GOV.UK select-last-resort. Overlap with extra 73: `nng.dropdown-ok-narrow-middle` / `nng.too-many-combobox-not-long-dropdown` / `govuk.select-last-resort`.
